_comment: Adjudication rule, applied mechanically. Agreement -> keep, confidence confident. Disagreement -> take v2 and mark guess. v2 wins because it alone had all eight categories. The disagreement is NOT resolved by argument: I authored v1 and am not a neutral adjudicator, so picking winners case by case would reintroduce exactly the bias the blind pass was built to remove. A guess flag is the honest record of two independent labelers failing to converge.
